module AliasRecordResultUsage

type AccountId is String
type Money is Integer

type Account is record
    id: AccountId
    balance: Money
end record

error MissingAccount

function load(id: AccountId) returns Result<Account, MissingAccount>
is
    return ok Account { id: id, balance: 10 }
end load

procedure main()
is
    let account: Result<Account, MissingAccount> = load("acct-1")
    check account.value.id = "acct-1"
    check account.value.balance = 10
end main

end AliasRecordResultUsage
